title: Track Handoff Contract
description: Typed, verifiable handoff from one parallel research track to the parent synthesizer (issue #416). Producer validates before handing off; parent re-validates before merging and must refuse schema-invalid handoffs instead of treating them as empty findings. Runtime enforcement lives in scripts/validate_track_handoff.py; this document is the canonical field vocabulary. Single-track research does not create Track Handoffs.

then.description: A complete track must carry at least one finding; empty arrays are reserved for partial/blocked with reasons.
partial and blocked tracks must explain why.
blocked tracks must state how the track can be retried.

schema_version.description: Contract version this handoff was produced against. Consumers reject unknown versions instead of guessing.

handoff_id.description: Stable identifier for this handoff artifact, e.g. track-2026-08-24-competitors. Reserved for the future Run State checkpoint work.

track_id.description: Identifier of the track that produced this handoff; consumers verify it against the track they dispatched.

question.description: The exact track question from the track design.

scope.description: Machine-checkable boundary of what this track covered. All four fields are required so parents can detect scope drift between tracks.

timeframe.description: Explicit period statement; use a plain phrase such as 'not time-bound' rather than omitting the field.

geography.description: Explicit geography statement; use 'global' or 'not geographic' rather than omitting the field.

source_register.description: Sources this track actually used. Every evidence_ref in findings must resolve here.

source_id.description: Stable local id, e.g. S01. Unique within this handoff.

url.description: Required: every track source must be explicitly traceable (SKILL.md requires explicit source URLs).

findings.description: Load-bearing findings. An empty findings array is only lawful for partial or blocked tracks; a complete track with no findings fails validation.

finding_id.description: Stable id, e.g. F01. Unique within this handoff; conflict finding_refs point here.

evidence_refs.description: Non-empty source_ids that must exist in this handoff's source_register.

conflicts.description: Overlapping claims that disagree. Empty array means the producer explicitly attests there are none.

then.description: A resolved conflict must state how it was resolved.

finding_refs.description: finding_ids involved in the conflict; must resolve within this handoff.

unknowns.description: Open questions with reason, impact, and next verification action. Never use an empty array to mean 'not executed'; use status partial/blocked with reasons instead.

implications.description: What this track implies for the overall research question; may be empty for tracks without decision relevance.

status.description: Execution status of the track. partial requires status_reason; blocked requires status_reason and recovery_action.

status_reason.description: Required for partial and blocked tracks.

recovery_action.description: Required for blocked tracks: what should be retried and how.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 date (2026-08-24) or timezone-aware RFC 3339 timestamp (2026-08-24T09:30:00Z). Impossible calendar values (2026-02-31) and naive datetimes without a zone offset fail validation.

artifact_ref.description: Optional forward-reference reserved for the Run State issue (#417). Not interpreted by the current validator beyond shape checking.
